criteria.rule_explanation: Conflicting coating evidence: coating process (hot-dip galvanized vs pre-galvanized (zinc-coated strip)); coating standard (EN ISO 1461 vs EN 10346); coating mass (≥ 505 g/m² vs 275 g/m²).
criteria.ai_explanation: The offer conflicts with the specification on all three attributes: pre-galvanized (zinc-coated strip) instead of hot-dip galvanized, EN 10346 instead of EN ISO 1461, and 275 g/m2 instead of the required minimum of 505 g/m2.

criteria.headline: No applicable standard found in the catalogue
criteria.rule_explanation: The catalogue does not state a standard designation that could be matched. Missing information is never treated as compliant.
criteria.ai_explanation: The catalogue does not state a standard designation, so compliance with EN 10219 is unverified and is not treated as compliant.

summary: Marmara Çelik is compliant on all five criteria, with dimensions, wall thickness, material grade, galvanizing and standard all matching or exceeding the specification. Karadeniz Boru is non-compliant on wall thickness, material grade and galvanizing, and its standard designation is unverified because the catalogue does not state one.
